checks.note: Audit events require agentTypeId and agentInstanceId (recorder.ts:12-13), and startup checks the computed id against the manifest (server.ts:32). The repo holds only the current manifest. Nothing maps older type ids to manifests, and no live-instance registry is in the repo.

The owner is a constant. The on-call channel appears only in README prose (README.md:73). CODEOWNERS maps paths to teams, not agent types to an on-call rotation. There is one agent type, and no ownership file maps it to a current operator.
